now.text: Freeze the 105-question audio bank and the six-question matched pilot inputs.
Source-check all 105 reference answers and bind them to the current spoken questions.
Run paired supporting-audio and original-history questions through Moshi, MiniCPM and DuplexOmni.
Compare reactive reading, amortized summaries and structured notes with the two Qwen3-30B readers.
Qualify the scorer on held-out real answers before the full-bank comparison.

definition.text: Reason while listening, then save and reuse the results when a user asks a question.

items.text: Keep 20 reviewed questions across six meetings, with answer facts and six clips of ordinary discussion.
Generate or revise and validate reference answers for all 105 questions.
Preserve the question recordings and keep evaluation speakers separate from earlier voice-tuning speakers.
Collect independent listening ratings before making stronger claims about voice quality and naturalness.
Compare full transcripts, recent speech, transcripts without speaker labels and automatic notes.
Review task owners, changed decisions, missing facts and unreliable earlier reasoning outputs.
The first note system loses useful facts and is not ready for speech tests.
Define the experiment families, notation and amortized-thinking terminology.
Implement shared S1 answer extraction, scoring and token accounting.
items.evidence: Evaluator v0.1.2 passes 46 CPU checks; original 43-check snapshot and three historical examples are retained separately.

items.text: Implement run-time progress updates from the same saved records as the checklists.
items.evidence: Native GPU-job phase/case updates and 30-second heartbeat are connected; public checkpoints use actual Slurm status and saved output records.

items.text: Check evaluator behavior on saved real outputs and labeled failure fixtures.
items.evidence: Three earlier real outputs and 43 CPU checks pass.

items.text: Run and inspect a small end-to-end DuplexOmni S1 pilot, including an early and a later request.
items.evidence: Three real meeting requests tested on one A100 80 GB; raw outputs, recorded speech and source facts reviewed. Full protocol remains unvalidated.

items.text: Publish an actual pilot output with its request, answer facts, score and explanation.
items.evidence: Actual input excerpts, S1 response audio, source facts, raw text and score explanations are published together.

items.text: Diagnose and repair empty or unusable S1 responses before full evaluation.
items.evidence: The revised sweep has 120/123 completed responses and 3 generation failures; source review finds 0/33 complete eligible answers. Native long-history recognition and full-bank validity remain unresolved.

items.text: Run both listening methods and inspect their meeting answers against source facts.
items.evidence: Two native listening methods: 4/4 meeting outputs saved and 4/4 source reviews recorded; full protocol remains unvalidated. Neither method gives a complete meeting answer; recognition remains unresolved.

items.text: Reproduce the working DailyTalk recipe and compare it with the current S1 runner.
items.evidence: The original helper and new native runner match all 40 response-field records; their spoken discount/full-price answers agree. P01 request-only recognition passes (WER 0.063), while its folder-status answer is unsupported without earlier evidence.

items.text: Review the original-input P01 sweep with every sentence-based increase in earlier context.
items.evidence: 41/41 contexts reviewed for one question; 20 preserve question meaning in ASR, and 0/11 eligible contexts give complete reference answers within 19.2 s.

items.text: Review the original-input microphone comparison across 41 histories and its spoken-response content.
items.evidence: Three signals at 41 lengths: 78 new native replays, 3 generation failures shown as gaps, 33 eligible spoken answers scored by a qualified local judge and audited against the source; 0 complete. One question; full protocol remains unvalidated.

items.text: Apply the acoustic revision to every recorded primary question and published voice alternative.
items.evidence: All 105 primary questions plus six voice alternatives revised; 111 source-PCM/timing checks and empty background-ASR controls. Seven paired-ASR caveats remain visible; no human naturalness claim.

items.text: Rerun all microphone/context positions with revised inputs and inspect actual spoken answers.
items.evidence: 123 positions freshly attempted, 120 completed responses, 3 generation failures shown as gaps; qualified local judge and source review cover 33 eligible answers, 0 complete.

items.text: Rerun the earlier eligible pilot controls and retain the long-prefix capacity exclusion.
items.evidence: Both native listening methods attempted P01/P02; 0/4 source-reviewed answers complete. P03 remains excluded by the unchanged full-prefix context limit.

items.text: Evaluate saved spoken responses using context, question and reference with separate quality dimensions.
items.evidence: Local Qwen3 judge: 120/120 ratings passing output/citation checks, anchored relevance/support/adequacy, qualification and 12 prompt-order probes; no new S1 speech. Full-bank evaluator validation remains pending.

items.text: Verify source-based reference answers for all 105 frozen questions.
items.evidence: 105/105 source reviews recorded; automated proposals/checks do not certify references.

items.text: Run matched supporting-audio and original-history questions through all three S1 systems.
items.evidence: 38/39 native outputs completed; 1 failed. All recorded attempts remain in accounting; this is execution status, not answer accuracy.

items.text: Compare reactive reading, amortized summaries and structured notes with Instruct and Thinking readers.
items.evidence: 48/48 final answers source-reviewed by Codex; six development/diagnostic questions, not full-bank accuracy.

items.text: Review the S1 answers against source facts and resolve response-transcription disagreements.
items.evidence: 0/38 completed native outputs have formal source-review records; three are runtime controls. A failed input cannot count as an answered question.

items.text: Qualify the generic scorer on 68 earlier real answers from 17 questions in five separate meetings.
items.evidence: Judge status: qualification_failed; fixed criteria and earlier Codex labels, no independent human ratings.

items.text: Qualify native S1 history and automatic judging, then freeze the evaluation protocol before broader experiments.
items.evidence: The one-question microphone sweep is reviewed and the revised local judge passed twelve authored checks; validate all 105 references, qualify judging on distinct questions and check the other S1 callers before full-bank evaluation.

items.text: Check every S1 caller and evaluate all 105 questions for each S1 model.
Select chunks and thinking goals on separate development meetings.
items.evidence: Question-blind 25–40 s chunks satisfy the 10–40 s plan; summary and structured-note goals are being tested on development meetings.

items.text: Run the remaining text and speech S2 conditions on all 105 questions.

stages.title: 4. Add tools and learn when to act

items.text: Add one document lookup with known results and a case where later speech changes the request.
Compare simple rules for listening, amortized thinking, answering, asking, using a tool and cancelling work.
Train an action policy only after the rules and scoring are reliable.
